> A mechanism that is powered by an adjustable escapement mechanism  to change how fast or slow it moves. The adjustable escapement mechanism would be like a module that could be added or removed easily to a hinge mechanism.

## Design

### 2026-10-18 – I worked on making the spiral spring, then I also worked on the escapement wheel and the lever. So far the hardest part here was the spiral spring and the lever, as I did not know how to work out the

**2.63h**

I worked on making the spiral spring, then I also worked on the escapement wheel and the lever. So far the hardest part here was the spiral spring and the lever, as I did not know how to work out the math to work with 3d printing, so I overcompensated with thicker parts, and I just eyeballed the angle of the lever ends.

I finished adding the springs and also added points to anchor parts to each other. ### 2026-10-26 – I reinforced some parts by adding fillets, especially thin parts, or thickening them. I did not remove the cover for the output shaft as it covers the ratchet and would let parts slide over it instead

**0.5h**

I reinforced some parts by adding fillets, especially thin parts, or thickening them. I did not remove the cover for the output shaft as it covers the ratchet and would let parts slide over it instead of getting caught in the spring under it.
